verified_facts.text: The Moana Surfrider opened in 1901 as the first hotel on Waikiki Beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opened on March 11, 1901, as the first hotel on Waikiki Beach

verified_facts.text: The Historic Banyan Wing honors architect Oliver G. Traphagen's original 1901 design, including its Beaux-Arts detailing.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Historic Banyan Wing honors architect Oliver G. Traphagen's original 1901 design, from the Beaux-Arts detailing to the beautiful crown molding.

verified_facts.text: Tower Wing rooms have a built-in reading nook and a deep lanai that opens the room to Pacific Ocean breezes.

verified_facts.text: The Surfrider Wing has a contemporary design drawn from surf culture, and its oceanfront rooms have rocking chairs with Pacific views.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a beachfront stretch of over 600 feet on Waikiki Beach.

verified_facts.text: The beachfront pool is set beneath the Banyan Tree.
